You will define project scope, objectives, resources and deliverables to mitigate risks and develop a comprehensive project plan and monitor project activities and resources until completion of project.
You will contribute to long range plans for the acquisition, management, delivery and control of information services under the cognizance of PSNS and IMF.
You will review, analyze, and assess IT programs for overall compliance with Federal, DOD, Department of the Navy (DON), Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA), and other policies.
You will ensure policies and procedures are in place so that information systems are reliable and accessible and defends against unauthorized access to application systems and data.
You will participate in strategic planning to support the design and implementation of streamlined processes that take full advantage of IT capabilities utilizing NAVSEA methodologies and tool sets, as required.
You will present controversial or political observations and findings relating to the effective and efficient use of Information Technology (IT) systems, applications, and information processing to those in the subordinate command or detachment.
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-12 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector providing oversight for analyzing, managing, or performing work necessary to plan, design, develop, acquire, document, test, implement, integrate, maintain, or modify systems for solving problems or accomplishing work processes by using Information Technology (IT) systems.

Your experience must reflect skill in the following areas: attention to detail, customer service, oral communication, and problem solving. Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

Provides program and project management support to the Division and district personnel.
Responsible for all programs management and funds control functions of the Military, IIS, and HTRW programs.
Recommend priorities within the limits of resources to ensure proper project execution and financial balance.
Oversee preparation of data for the District's annual workload forecasting effort and consolidate programming data into the AIS for future resource planning.
Participate in policy development and program planning for Division-wide activities to ensure district policy conforms to existing precedents, practices, and guidelines.
Serve as the District's staff authority and consultant on program management, providing expert advice on program policy, funding, scheduling, and manpower to the District Commander and Deputy District Engineer.
Oversee and lead District efforts to meet initiatives of transforming the organization in regard to governance, business practices, and data analytics.
Represent the District and provide advice and guidance on program and project operations, negotiating with concerned parties to gain compliance with established policies.
Provide leadership and strategic recommendations to senior management regarding the Military, HTRW, IIS, and Civil Works programs and budget allocations.
Supervise the PPCO workforce and work operation, planning and scheduling the office's work and making assignments based on capabilities, priorities, and project difficulty.
Initiate and submit requests for personnel actions, select candidates for PPCO positions, establish performance objectives, evaluate employee performance, and initiate performance awards.
Interpret and determine the impact of pertinent legislation on the District's programs, projects, and budget formulations to ensure compliance.
Who May Apply: Only applicants who meet one of the employment authority categories below are eligible to apply for this job. You will be asked to identify which category or categories you meet, and to provide documents which prove you meet the category or categories you selected.

See Proof of Eligibility for an extensive list of document requirements for all employment authorities.

Current Department of Army Civilian Employees Domestic Defense Industrial Base/Major Range and Test Facilities Base Civilian Personnel Workforce Interagency Career Transition Assistance Plan Land Management Workforce Flexibility Act Military Spouses, under Executive Order (E.O.) 13473 Priority Placement Program, DoD Military Reserve (MR) and National Guard (NG) Technician Eligible Priority Placement Program, DoD Military Spouse Preference (MSP) Eligible Priority Placement Program, DoD MR and NG Preference Eligible Tech Receiving Disability Retirement Priority Placement Program, DoD Retained Grade Preference Eligible Veterans Employment Opportunity Act (VEOA) of 1998 In order to qualify, you must meet the experience requirements described below.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student; social). You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Your resume must clearly describe your relevant experience; if qualifying based on education, your transcripts will be required as part of your application. Additional information about transcripts is in this document.

You must also meet the specialized experience as indicated in the below statement: Specialized Experience Statement: One year of specialized experience which includes managing and coordinating complex programs or projects; analyzing funding, resource requirements, schedules, and performance to support program execution; providing advice and recommendations on complex program management issues; and coordinating with senior leaders and stakeholders to resolve issues and achieve organizational objectives.

This definition of specialized experience is typical of work performed at the next lower grade/level position in the federal service (GS-13).

You will be evaluated on the basis of your level of competency in the following areas: Accountability Customer Service Decisiveness Flexibility Interpersonal Skills Problem Solving Resilience Time in Grade Requirement: Applicants who have held a General Schedule (GS) position within the last 52 weeks must have 52 weeks of Federal service at the next lower grade or equivalent (GS-13).

The BHIP Program Manager serves as the supervisor of the BHIP Team, leading and supervising a multidisciplinary team of physicians, physician extenders, nurses, psychologists, social workers, and/or other staff members.

Total Rewards of a Allied Health Professional Duties include, but are not limited to: Responsible for organizing and assigning work to be performed; performance evaluations; selection of staff, training, and recommendation of awards, advancements, and when appropriate, disciplinary action.

Plan and organize work to be accomplished by team members, set, and adjust priorities and assign duties based on capabilities of employees, so that our teams can operate effectively. Develop, monitor and adjust tours of duty and schedules for clinicians to provide care in person and via telehealth.

Monitor productivity, clinic utilization, and metrics of staff members and BHIP teams. Develop timely responses to action items while coordinating across services within the catchment area, VISN and National programs.

Provides individual, group, and family psychotherapy and counseling to veterans and family members as indicated through assessment process.

Provides a full range of screening, assessment, diagnosis, and therapeutic interventions for a variety of psychiatric disorders with a strong emphasis on the application of time ­limited, evidence-based approaches. Develop treatment plans with veterans through use of shared decision making.

Completes a discharge plan when patients have reached their identified goals, integrating internal and external support resources for the Veteran upon discharge as applicable. Provide professional advice and consultation in areas related to professional psychology and behavioral health.

Assist in the design and implementation of effective treatment strategies to meet veteran needs. Assist with clinic access contingency plans by adjusting appointment times, locations, or dates as well as connecting Veterans with other providers due to staffing or coverage issues.

Work Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7:30am-4:00pm (subject to change based on facility needs) Recruitment Incentive (Sign-on Bonus): Not Authorized Permanent Change of Station (Relocation Assistance): Not Authorized EDRP Authorized: Former EDRP participants ineligible to apply for incentive.

Contact VHA.ELRSProgramSupport@va.gov, the EDRP Coordinator for questions/assistance. Learn more Pay: Competitive salary and regular salary increases. When setting pay, a higher step rate of the appropriate grade may be determined after consideration of higher or unique qualifications or special needs of the VA (Above Minimum Rate of the Grade).

Paid Time Off: 37-50 days of annual paid time offer per year (13-26 days of annual leave, 13 days of sick leave, 11 paid Federal holidays per year) Selected applicants may qualify for credit toward annual leave accrual, based on prior [work experience] or military service experience.

Parental Leave: After 12 months of employment, up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave in connection with the birth, adoption, or foster care placement of a child.

Child Care Subsidy: After 60 days of employment, full time employees with a total family income below $144,000 may be eligible for a childcare subsidy up to 25% of total eligible childcare costs for eligible children up to the monthly maximum of $416.66.

Retirement: Traditional federal pension (5 years vesting) and federal 401K with up to 5% in contributions by VA Insurance: Federal health/vision/dental/term life/long-term care (many federal insurance programs can be carried into retirement) Telework: Available Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

Functional Statement #: 01305F Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized
Applicants pending the completion of educational or certification/licensure requirements may be referred and tentatively selected but may not be hired until all requirements are met. Basic Requirements: United States Citizenship. Non-citizens may only be appointed when it is not possible to recruit qualified citizens in accordance with VA Policy.

Education. Have a doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA), the Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS), or the Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) at the time the program was completed.

The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed. For the purpose of meeting this requirement, the term "specialty area" refers to the specific specialty areas recognized by the accrediting body and not to specific job duties that might require special skills.

Currently, APA accredits doctoral programs in the specialty areas of clinical psychology, counseling psychology, school psychology, or combinations of two or more of those areas. PCSAS accredits doctoral programs in psychological clinical science.

CPA accredits doctoral programs in clinical psychology, counseling psychology, clinical neuropsychology, and school psychology. There are no job assignments in VHA that require the skills of a school psychologist; therefore, an applicant with a degree in the specialty area of school psychology is not eligible for appointment.

Strictly for the purpose of determining eligibility for appointment as a psychologist in VHA, there is no distinction between the specialty areas (with the exception of school psychology).

OR Have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and, in addition, successfully complete a re- specialization program (including documentation of an approved internship completed as part of the re- specialization program) meeting both of the following conditions: (a) The re-specialization program must be completed in an APA or a CPA accredited doctoral program; and, (b) the specialty in which the applicant is retrained must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR Have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution, with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature. AND Internships.

Have successfully completed a professional psychology internship training program that was accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed and that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR New VHA psychology internship programs that are in the process of applying for APA accreditation are acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement, provided that such programs were sanctioned by the VHA Central Office Program Director for Psychology and the VHA Office of Academic Affiliations at the time that the individual was an intern; OR VHA facilities that offered full-time, one-year pre-doctoral internships prior to PL 96- 151 (pre- 1979) are considered to be acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement; OR Applicants who completed an internship that was not accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed may be considered eligible for hire only if they are currently board certified by the American Board of Professional Psychology in a specialty area that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

(NOTE: Once board certified, the employee is required to maintain board certification.) OR Applicants who have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally- accredited institution with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature may fulfill this internship requirement by having the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience in a site specifically acceptable to the candidate's doctoral program.

If the internship experience is not noted on the applicant's official transcript, the applicant must provide a statement from the doctoral program verifying that the equivalent of a one- year supervised internship experience was completed in a site acceptable to the doctoral program. Licensure.

Hold a full, current, and unrestricted license to practice psychology at the doctoral level in a State, Territory, or Commonwealth of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

May qualify based on being covered by the Grandfathering Provision as described in the VA Qualification Standard for this occupation (only applicable to current VHA employees who are in this occupation and meet the criteria). Grade Determinations: Psychology Program Manager, GS-14 Experience.

At least three years of experience as a professional psychologist, with at least one year equivalent to the GS-13 grade level. Demonstrated Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities.

In addition to the experience above, the candidate must demonstrate all of the following KSAs: Ability to organize work, set priorities, delegate tasks, and meet multiple deadlines. Knowledge of and ability to utilize evidence based practices and clinical practice guidelines appropriately and ability to guide staff in using these tools.

Ability to deal effectively with individuals or groups. Skill in managing and directing the work of others to accomplish program goals and objectives. Ability to translate management goals and objectives into well-coordinated and controlled work operations. Ability to establish and monitor production and performance priorities and standards.

Ability to analyze organizational and operational problems and to develop and implement solutions that result in sound operation of the program. Preferred Experience: Data-driven approach: outcome monitoring, quality improvement initiatives.

Knowledge of current behavioral health trends: trauma-informed care, motivational interviewing, collaborative care models. Excellent multidisciplinary communication and collaboration skills. Reference: For more information on this qualification standard, please visit https://www.va.gov/ohrm/QualificationStandards/.

The full performance level of this vacancy is GS-14. Physical Requirements: Physical aspects associated with work required of this assignment are typical for the occupation, see Duties section for essential job duties of the position. May require standing, lifting, carrying, sitting, stooping, bending, puling, and pushing.

May be required to wear personal protective equipment and undergo annual TB screening or testing as conditions of employment. Work Environment: Work is performed in an office/clinic setting with minimal risks that requires normal safety precautions; the area is adequately lighted, heated, and ventilated.

However, the work environment requires someone with the ability to handle several tasks at once in sometimes stressful situations.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Enterprise Project Manager
Canonical’s mission is to streamline and accelerate the adoption of open source across the entire global enterprise technology market. Our customers embrace the Canonical approach to open source for complex projects on bare metal, on the cloud, and at the edge. Canonical Enterprise Project Managers are responsible for ensuring project success through owning, driving, communicating and respectfully engaging all stakeholders, valuing integrity and accountability.
Within a portfolio of projects with complex and changing software technologies, customer and partner satisfaction is only possible because of exceptional Project Managers who know how to respect and engage all stakeholders.
Location: This is a Globally remote role.

Ensuring programs and projects are delivered within the schedule, scope, cost, budget and resources expectations
Identifying key technical and project risks and issues and actively put mitigating actions in place
Maintaining strong customer focus and working with all key stakeholders to achieve successful outcomes
Conducting regular status meetings and business reviews with customers and providing direction when needed
Managing the delivery schedule of critical third party deliverables for the project
Advocating to customers the appropriate technologies from Canonical's portfolio
Driving project success while managing risks

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company.

We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

About Phase2 Our remote first employees join and stay at Phase2 to be a force . In pursuit of digital experience that advances the human experience, you will do your best work, live fully, and succeed as a team.

Phase2 a digital agency passionate about customer experience, grounded in data & insights, and rooted in more than two decades of successful technology delivery. We guide industry-leading companies to what’s next in their digital slandscape. And it all begins with finding the right people who align with our values and passion for impact.

About the Role Phase2 is seeking a Senior Project Manager to own complex digital engagements and lead trusted, senior-level client relationships. Project managers often focus on the triple constraint of scope, time, and cost, but Phase2 is seeking a different breed of PM who can think beyond constraints.

Project Managers at Phase2 create a unique, engaging, and impactful client experience with long-term outcomes. They bring a future-focused perspective, anticipate client needs, and ensure decisions and direction align with what will drive meaningful progress and outcomes.

They bring clarity to ambiguity, guide clients through key decisions, and keep work moving forward, ensuring clients feel confident, supported, and satisfied.

This position reports to: VP, Project Management Compensation: Base annual salary of $120,000 - $155,000 What You’ll Do Own multi-workstream engagements end-to-end, ensuring delivery stays aligned with client goals, expected outcomes, and organizational standards.

Set direction by translating client objectives into structured plans, decision frameworks, and actionable priorities. Drive outcomes and client value with an emphasis on rapid time to value, using practical delivery discipline and AI-enabled approaches to accelerate insight, execution, and impact.

Lead the client relationship with confidence and clarity, ensuring expectations are understood, risks and mitigations are discussed early, and decisions continue moving forward. Direct cross-functional teams by establishing clear and outcome-aligned workflows, communication patterns, and accountability across all contributors.

Take ownership of engagement financials, including scope, forecasting, staffing, and margin performance, adjusting plans as conditions shift. Own and evolve the engagement roadmap and delivery approach ensuring work is sequenced to drive momentum, demonstrate value early, and unlock what’s next.

Embed AI tools into engagement workflows to strengthen planning, insight generation, communication, and decision support—setting expectations for how teams use AI to improve clarity, efficiency, and quality of work. Provide grounded recommendations that help clients evaluate tradeoffs, understand implications, and make informed decisions.

Identify risks early, lead mitigation efforts, and ensure issues are resolved with clarity and speed. Recognize and shape opportunities that arise naturally from delivery insight, client context, or emerging needs. Support the creation of proposals, estimates, and scopes that reflect realistic delivery plans and forward-looking client priorities.

What You’ll Need Significant experience owning complex digital engagements and leading senior client relationships. A strong instinct for bringing order to complexity—setting direction, aligning teams, and maintaining steady progress across multiple workstreams.

Demonstrated ability to solve problems creatively and constructively, balancing constraints across scope, budget, timelines, and team capacity without compromising outcomes. Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to lead client discussions, present recommendations, and guide decisions.

Deep understanding of digital platforms, product development lifecycles, and modern delivery practices. Demonstrated ability to embed AI in daily workflows and deliverables—using it to accelerate analysis, sharpen communication, synthesize information, and elevate the overall quality of engagement leadership.

Experience guiding teams in responsible, effective AI use, ensuring it enhances outcomes, improves speed and structure, and supports stronger decision-making. A track record of identifying meaningful opportunities rooted in client strategy, delivery insight, or future potential. Agency or consultancy experience preferred.

What Success Looks Like Clients feel led, supported, and confident in both the direction and decisions of the engagement. Teams operate with clarity, alignment, and consistent direction, even as priorities evolve. Engagements maintain predictable delivery, proactive risk management, and stable momentum.

Decisions are shaped with context, structure, and clear implications, enabling clients to move forward confidently. Clients feel energized and inspired by the clarity, momentum, and possibilities the partnership creates. New opportunities emerge naturally because the work is thoughtful, high-performing, and forward-looking.

Engagements meet expectations across delivery quality, relationship strength, and commercial performance. What You’ll Get The chance to make a real impact in the health and wellness space, helping millions of people per year. To work from wherever you thrive best. We’re a remote-first team built on trust, flexibility, and outcomes.

A competitive compensation package that considers various factors. A comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, and supplemental insurance. Our fun and interactive wellness program offers rewards for participation.

A 401(k) with a 3% employer contribution–no match required and 100% vested after just 90 days. You’ll start with 16 paid vacation days, 4 personal days, and 1 volunteer day each year. Vacation and personal time increase with your tenure, recognizing your continued contributions.

Up to 12 weeks of fully paid leave for birthing parents and up to 6 weeks of fully paid bonding leave, based on your tenure. This includes support for adoption and foster placement, along with the option to extend time off through additional unpaid leave.

Inclusive fertility, adoption, and surrogacy benefits through Kindbody, along with virtual health coaching and care navigation. A $500 stipend to personalize and equip your home workspace for success. What the Environment Looks Like Physical Demands Frequently remain in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods of time.

Occasional adjusting or moving of light objects up to 20 pounds in all directions. Continuous communication on live video chats, calls, and through emails and messaging platforms for the purpose of exchanging information. Continuous repetitive movements that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. Travel, sometimes frequent, is expected.

Mental Demands Comprehension - Must continuously be able to understand direction and adhere to established procedures. Must also be able to gather information from clients and employees and synthesize this information in a meaningful way. May also be responsible for making improvements or recommendations to existing procedures.

Organization - Must continuously be able to gather and classify information, store information learned from conversations and communications, and then be and be able to quickly recall, interpret, and explain information. Reasoning and Decision Making - Must continuously use logic to analyze and interpret information, and prioritize.

Communication - Must continuously express or exchange ideas and meaning with employees and clients. Resilience - Must continuously adapt well in the face of workplace stressors. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or any other protected status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process.

Wir sind eine der am schnellstwachsenden Digitalagenturen Hamburgs und suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt neue Mitarbeiter/innen für das Projektmanagement.
Was macht die Cordes Consulting GmbH genau?
Wir sind eine Werbeagentur, welche Handwerksunternehmen durch innovative Social-Media-Strategien dabei hilft, mehr Bewerbungen von Fachkräften aus der Region zu erhalten. Wir vermarkten also mittelständische Unternehmen als attraktive Arbeitgeber in den sozialen Netzwerken.
Wenn dir analytisch-methodisches und strukturiertes Denken sowie Organisationsfähigkeit liegt und du gerne mit Kunden kommunizierst, ist diese Stelle genau das richtige für dich!
Als Projektmanager/in bist du das Bindeglied zwischen unseren Agenturkunden und unserem Online-Marketing-Team. Du organisierst Kundenprojekte und delegierst die einzelnen Teilaufgaben an die zuständigen Kolleginnen und Kollegen innerhalb des Marketing-Teams.

Pflege und Ausbau der Kundenbeziehung zu unseren Agenturkunden (renommierte mittelständische Unternehmen)
Erfassung von Kundenwünschen sowie Vorstellung und Ausarbeitung neuer Marketingstrategien
Interne Planung von Kundenprojekten (Online-Marketing-Kampagnen) und Delegation der einzelnen Arbeitsschritte
Durchführung von Strategieplanungsterminen mit unseren Neukunden zum erfolgreichen Start in der Zusammenarbeit
Regelmäßige Feedback-Meetings mit unseren Kunden zum Verlauf der Zusammenarbeit führen
Verantwortung und Sicherstellung der Kundenzufriedenheit von unseren Agenturkunden
Inhaltliche Fragen von Kunden zum Verlauf der Zusammenarbeit und zu Werbekampagnen beantworten (telefonisch und schriftlich)
E-Mail-Support für eingehende Anfragen von Bestandskunden leisten
Sicherstellung und Verbesserung der Kundenzufriedenheit
Für unsere Stellen in der Kundenbetreuung sind keine Vorerfahrungen in den Bereichen "Social-Media" oder "Marketing" erforderlich. Während unserer ausführlichen Einarbeitung lernst du alles, was du für deine neue Tätigkeit an Fachwissen benötigst.
Wenn du weitere Informationen zu unserem Unternehmen und deiner Karriere bei Cordes Consulting haben möchtest, findest du diese auf www.cordes-karriere.de.
Gehalt: Senior Projektmanager - Vollzeit (m/w/d): 5.600 brutto im Monat.
Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sind vorhanden.

Eine gute Vergütung über dem Branchendurchschnitt.
Die Möglichkeit früh Verantwortung zu übernehmen: Da du eigenständig Kundenprojekte planst, Strategien erarbeitest und delegierst, kannst du schnell eigenverantwortlich arbeiten.
Ausführliche interne Schulung: Durch unser internes Schulungssystem lernst du alles, was du für deine neue Tätigkeit bei uns im Unternehmen benötigst.
Hervorragende Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten : Über die nächsten Jahre werden wir weiter stark wachsen.
Einen tollen Firmenstandort in der Hamburger Innenstadt mit moderner Arbeitsausstattung
Eine tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Uns ist ein positives Umfeld wichtig. Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang.
Ein dynamisches Team ein motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld.
Einen sichereren Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme.
Eine erstklassige Büroausstattung: Wir arbeiten ausschließlich mit moderner Technik und Arbeitsausstattung.
Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Deutschlandticket oder einen Tiefgaragenstellplatz in unserem Bürogebäude.
Cordes Consulting Gesundheitssystem: Profitiere von umfangreichen Gesundheitsleistungen für dich und deine Familienangehörigen (u. a. 900 € jährliches Gesundheitsbudget für Privatleistungen, Facharzt-Terminvereinbarung innerhalb von 5-10 Tagen, ärztliche Zweitmeinung sowie ein 24/7 Gesundheitstelefon)
Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich BWL oder Marketing
Relevante Vorkenntnisse und Erfahrung in den Themenbereichen Projektmanagement, Marketing oder Key-Account-Management
Einschlägige Projekterfahrung im Online-Marketing (insbesondere bezahlte Werbekampagnen auf Facebook, Instagram, TikTok & Co.)
Analytisch-methodisches und strukturiertes Denken, Organisationsfähigkeit, Ergebnis- und Lösungsorientierung sowie ausgeprägte Teamorientierung gepaart mit sicherem Auftreten, einer selbstständigen Arbeitsweise und einem hohen Maß an Kommunikationsfähigkeit.
Die Fähigkeit, bestehenden Prozessen zu folgen.
Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und hohe Disziplin.
Starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Präzision.
Saubere und fehlerfreie schriftliche Ausdrucksform in Deutsch.
Guter Umgang mit Leistungsdruck.

We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. We're looking for a Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise software implementations. This is a client-facing role at the center of every engagement: you'll translate what a customer needs into a plan, drive a cross-functional team to build it, and keep both sides aligned from kickoff to go-live and beyond.

You won't just track tasks, you'll understand the product deeply, engage in technical conversations with solution architects and engineers, lead the business requirement sessions, and make the decisions that keep delivery on track. The best person for this role thinks like an owner of the account, not a coordinator of it.

Own delivery end to end: Run enterprise implementation projects from kickoff through go-live and stabilization, accountable for scope, timeline, budget, quality, and client satisfaction on every engagement you lead.
Build & manage the plan: Break down complex, ambiguous requirements into a clear project plan with phases, milestones, dependencies, and owners, keeping it current and making trade-offs visible when reality shifts.
Lead requirements gathering: Own the business requirement sessions end to end, facilitating discovery workshops that surface what the client actually needs, documenting requirements in a structured, unambiguous format, managing sign-off, and keeping them traceable through design, build, and testing.
Run the cross-functional team: Coordinate solution architects, engineers, QA, and client stakeholders toward a shared outcome, removing blockers, resolving conflicts, and making sure everyone knows what they own and by when.
Own the client relationship: Be the client's primary point of contact, leading status meetings, steering committee updates, and escalations, setting expectations early, and protecting the relationship even during hard conversations.
Manage scope, risk & change: Hold the line on scope creep, documenting and quantifying changes before work starts, and manage risks and issues proactively with a live view of mitigation plans and early escalation.
Stay technical, report & improve: Understand the architecture, integrations, and configuration decisions well enough to challenge estimates and speak credibly with engineers and technical buyers, produce honest, easy-to-read status reports and executive updates, and feed lessons learned back into delivery methodology.
What Success Looks Like
On-target delivery: Projects land on time, on budget, and within scope, with a clear plan stakeholders trust.
Trusted clients: Clients feel informed and in control throughout the engagement, and would take your call for the next one.
Managed risk: Risks surface early and get managed, so escalations are rare and never a surprise.
Aligned team & clean handoffs: The delivery team is aligned, unblocked, and clear on priorities, and handoffs to support and account teams are clean, with nothing left undocumented.
What You'll Need
Experience: 5+ years managing technical or software implementation projects, ideally in enterprise SaaS, professional services, or a client-facing delivery environment, with a track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects on time and within budget as the primary delivery owner for enterprise clients.
Technical fluency: You can read a solution design, understand integrations and data flows, and hold your own in a technical discussion without being the engineer.
Requirements & delivery craft: Proven ability to run requirements and discovery sessions and translate them into clear, documented business requirements, plus solid command of project management fundamentals (planning, estimation, dependency management, risk and issue tracking, and change control).
Stakeholder management: Excellent communication, comfort presenting to senior and executive audiences, and the ability to manage scope, timelines, and difficult conversations without losing the relationship.
Ways of working: Organized and calm under pressure, you over-communicate rather than under-communicate, you're direct when a project needs a hard truth and diplomatic when a relationship needs care, and you own outcomes rather than pointing to a process.
Preferred: An earlier technical role (engineering, solution architecture, or implementation consulting); experience delivering configurable enterprise platforms or workflow/automation software; fluency in both agile and traditional delivery and the judgment to know when to use which; experience in a regulated or risk-sensitive domain; PMP, PRINCE2, PSM, or equivalent certification; and exposure to AI-assisted or modern delivery tooling.

Für unsere Abteilung Übergangswohnen suchen wir per 01.12.2026 oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte und erfahrene Führungsperson.
## Aufgaben ##
* Sie übernehmen die fachliche, personelle und finanzielle Gesamtverantwortung für die Abteilung Übergangswohnen und entwickeln die vielfältigen Angebote gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team weiter.
* Sie stellen eine hohe Qualität der Dienstleistungen sicher und verantworten die Bereiche Sicherheit, Organisation sowie den nachhaltigen und effizienten Einsatz der vorhandenen Ressourcen.
* Sie initiieren, leiten und begleiten Projekte innerhalb der Abteilung und bringen Ihr Fachwissen aktiv in bereichsübergreifende Vorhaben des Geschäftsbereichs ein.
* Sie vertreten die Abteilung kompetent gegenüber internen sowie externen Partner\*innen, pflegen bestehende Netzwerke und bauen tragfähige Beziehungen im Sozialraum kontinuierlich aus.
* Sie gestalten als Mitglied des Bereichsleitungsgremiums die strategische und fachliche Ausrichtung des Geschäftsbereichs aktiv mit und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung des Geschäftsbereichs.
## Profil ##
* Masterabschluss (FH oder Uni) im sozialen Bereich sowie eine Führungsweiterbildung und Kenntnisse/Erfahrungen im Bereich Psychiatrie von Vorteil
* Führungserfahrung und Begeisterung für die Weiterentwicklung von Mitarbeiter\*innen, den bestehenden Angeboten sowie der gesamten Organisationen
* Erfahrungen in der Projektleitung und Gestaltung von Veränderungsprozessen
* Analyse anspruchsvoller Situationen sowie Treffen von fundierten und nachvollziehbaren Entscheidungen
* Wertschätzende und klare Kommunikation gegenüber unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen
* Vernetztes Denken und Handeln zur Förderung der Zusammenarbeit über Abteilungs- und Bereichsgrenzen hinweg
* Verständnis für gesellschaftliche sowie politische Zusammenhänge und deren Auswirkungen auf die strategische Weiterentwicklung der Angebote
## Wir bieten ##
Eine abwechslungsreiche, herausfordernde und vielseitige Führungsaufgabe mit Gestaltungsspielraum und direkter Wirkung. Neben einem attraktiven Arbeitsplatz im Herzen der Stadt Zürich sowie einem engagierten und motivierten Team, profitieren Sie von verschiedenen Anstellungsbedingungen.

## Über uns ##
Die Abteilung Übergangswohnen umfasst verschiedene Wohnangebote für junge Erwachsene, Einzelpersonen, Paare und Familien sowie eine Notunterkunft für Familien. Als Abteilungsleiter\*in tragen Sie die fachliche, personelle, organisatorische und finanzielle Gesamtverantwortung für die Abteilung. Sie führen und entwickeln die Mitarbeitenden und sorgen gemeinsam mit ihnen dafür, dass unsere Angebote fachlich überzeugen, gut funktionieren und sich an den Bedürfnissen der Menschen orientieren.
Mit rund 2400 Mitarbeitenden setzt sich das Sozialdepartement der Stadt Zürich täglich für ein soziales Zürich ein. Wir sind für alle da und unterstützen Kinder, Jugendliche und Erwachsene in unterschiedlichen Lebenslagen. Wir leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zum gesellschaftlichen Zusammenhalt. Und wir tragen zu einer hohen Lebensqualität in den Quartieren bei.

## Projektleiterin Übergangswohnen (40%) ##
Eintritt per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung, befristet auf 9 Monate mit Möglichkeit zur Verlängerung
Du gestaltest den Ausbau und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Übergangswohnangebote massgeblich mit.
Deine Aufgaben
* Du entwickelst das Fach- und Betriebskonzept sowie die organisatorischen und finanziellen Grundlagen weiter
* Du planst, koordinierst und steuerst die nächsten Umsetzungsschritte.
* Du entwickelst Prozesse, Standards und Arbeitsinstrumente
* Du verantwortest die Suche, Prüfung und Bereitstellung geeigneter Wohnlösungen.
* Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden, Fachstellen und Partnerorganisationen
* Du wirkst an der nachhaltigen Verankerung und Weiterentwicklung des Angebots mit.
Was du mitbringst
* Hochschulabschluss in Sozialer Arbeit, Sozialwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet
* Erfahrung in der Projektleitung und Angebotsentwicklung im sozialen Bereich
* Kenntnisse in den Bereichen häusliche Gewalt, Opferhilfe und/oder begleitete Wohnformen von Vorteil
* Konzeptionelle Stärke und eine strukturierte, selbständige Arbeitsweise
* Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an Vernetzung und Zusammenarbeit
* Freude daran, ein wachsendes Angebot mitzugestalten
Was wir dir bieten
* Sinnstiftende Arbeit mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum
* Ein engagiertes Team mit gegenseitiger Unterstützung
* Intervision, Supervision und Weiterbildung
* Faire Anstellungsbedingungen und gute Sozialleistungen
